GetArpTable.longDescription: This action shall display ARP table entries. Returns ARP table output with numeric IP addresses and MAC addresses.

GetInterfaceConfiguration.longDescription: This action shall display network interface configuration. Returns network interface output showing all network interfaces with IP addresses, MAC addresses, and statistics.

GetNetworkStatistics.description: Display network connections and routing tables.
GetNetworkStatistics.longDescription: This action shall display network statistics and connection information. Returns network statistics output showing all active connections.

GetTraceLog.longDescription: This action shall display trace log information. Returns trace log output showing all trace log entries.

Ping.longDescription: This action shall test network connectivity to the specified IP address or domain name with count range checking (1-10). Returns network connectivity test output.
